transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Tired all the time, no energy.
When did you first start feeling this tired?
It came on slowly, maybe two months ago.
Have you ever had an allergy or a bad reaction to any medicine?
Codeine makes me very sick.
How much does the tiredness affect what you can do in a typical day?
My husband has Parkinson's, I'm his main carer.
Can you tell me if you've started or changed any medicines recently?
I take ibuprofen most days now for my shoulder.
Can you tell me about any health problems that have lasted a long time?
I've had type 2 diabetes for years.
How would you describe the tiredness on a typical day: mild, moderate, or severe, or you're not sure?
I'd say about 3 out of 10.
Along with the tiredness, have you noticed anything else going on?
More short of breath than usual on hills.
Where in your body do you feel the tiredness most?
It's all over really, not one spot.
Have you noticed anything that seems to make the tiredness better or worse?
Worse in the afternoons.
What worries you most about how you've been feeling?
Worried I won't be able to keep caring for him.
Can you describe what the tiredness feels like to you?
Like I just can't keep going.
Besides your diabetes, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add, such as other ongoing health problems, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays?
I've got an underactive thyroid too.
Are you taking any other medicines at the moment, besides the ibuprofen for your shoulder?
I had to stop my swimming classes.
Besides feeling more short of breath when you walk on hills, is there anything else you’ve noticed that’s been different for you?
Friends say I look pale.
Besides your diabetes and underactive thyroid, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
My mother had similar problems, she was always tired too.
Besides the ibuprofen for your shoulder, is there anything else you take for your health?
I take metformin for the diabetes.
Besides feeling tired, is there anything else that’s been different for you?
I need a nap most days now.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
